description: The National Centre of Public Health and Analyses produces Bulgaria's official health statistics through its directorate for national health data and e-health, working with the National Statistical Institute and the regional health inspectorates. The page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the centre is a statistics body in the national statistical system, working under the national statistical programme and the EU regulations on public health statistics, including the 2022 implementing rules on statistics of health care facilities, health workforce and use of health care. Its publications are annual statistical yearbooks, a short handbook and a joint publication titled Healthcare, and annual thematic bulletins, including one on the bed stock and activity of inpatient facilities, plus hospitalised morbidity, cancer registrations, mortality by cause and disability. Coverage is Bulgaria, by region in many tables. Access is free; no licence is stated, and the file formats of the publications were not read. Caveats: the publications were not opened, so years and table layouts are unconfirmed. It supports health service capacity studies, such as comparing hospital beds and admissions by district to assess surge capacity. Related record: Romania's DRG hospital indicators.
